senses.gloss: अभिकाङ्क्षिन् a. wishing for, desirous of (acc. or —˚).
अभिकॢप्त a. formed or manifested by (instr.)

अभिक्रम m. approaching (also ˚ण n.), undertaking,
overcoming.
अभिक्षदा॑ a. giving without being asked.

अभिगम m. ˚न n. coming near, going to, approaching
(also of sex. intercourse).
अभिगम्य a. to be approached, accessible.

अभिजन m. origin, race, family. ancestors, ˚वन्त् =
seq. adj.

अभिजात a. well or nobly-born;
 n. = seq.
आभिजाती f. ˚जात्य n. noble birth, generosity.

अभिजि॑त् a. victorious, m. a cert. sacrifice, N. of a
lunar mansion.

अभिज्ञ a. knowing, understanding, acquainted with,
skilled in (gen. or —˚). f. आ remembrance, recollection.

अभिज्ञान n. = prec. f.;
 recognition or sign of
recognition. ˚शकुन्तल n. T. of a drama (the Token or
Ring-Śakuntala).
अभिज्ञु॑ adv. on or up to the knees.

अभिधा॑ a. surrounding;
 f. name, appellation.

अभिधानकोश^1 m. a dictionary
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: aBiDAnakoSa cf. PW.

अभिध्यान n. thinking of (gen.), longing for, coveting
(loc.).
अभिनन्दनीय a. to be praised or rejoiced at.
अभि˚नन्द्य a. to be praised or rejoiced at.
अभिनभ्य॑म् adv. up to the sky.

अभिनय m. pantomime, dramatic representation;
˚याचार्य m. teacher of this art.

अभिनिम्रुक्त a. on whom the sun sets, i.e. whom the
setting sun finds sleeping.

अभिनिविष्ट a. entered, penetrated, fixed, settled,
intent upon, attached to (loc., acc. w. प्रति, or —˚), endowed with
(instr.).

अभिनिवेश m. inclination, attachment to (loc. or —˚);
intentness, resolution, tenacity.
अभिनिवेशिन् a. inclined, adhering, clinging to (—˚).

अ॑भिन्न a. uncleft, unpierced, unbroken, uninterrupted,
whole, entire, continual, undivided, one, the same as, not different
from (abl. or —˚).
अभिपरिप्लुत a. filled with, full of (instr.).

अभिपित्व॑ n. approach, arrival, stopping, esp. of the
day, i.e. evening.
अभिपूर्ण a. filled, full of (instr., gen., or —˚).
अभिप्रेप्सु a. desirous of, wishing for (acc.).

अभिप्लुत a. visited by, suffering^1 from (instr.).
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

अभिभव a. predominant, superior. m. predominance,
superiority, overthrow, humiliation, defeat (also अभिभव˚न n.).
अभि॑भूति a. & f. = अभिभव॑ adj. & m.
अभिमत a. approved, wished for, dear.

अभि॑माति f. plot, hostility;
 plotter, adversary, enemy.

अभियोक्तृ assailing;
 m. enemy, plaintiff, claimant.

अभिरुत a. sounding;
 n. sound, cry.

अभिरुचित a. pleasing, agreeable (dat. or gen);
pleased with, delighting in (—˚).

अभि॑रूप a. suitable, apt, beautiful (also ˚वन्त्†);
learned, wise.

अभिलाष m. desire, wish (loc. or —˚);
 poss. ˚षिन्.

अभिवाञ्छित a. wished for;
 n. wish.

अभिविख्यात a. celebrated;
 known as, called (इति).

अभिव्यक्त a. apparent, clear;
 n. adv.

अभिशी॑ a. closing or closed together;
 joining or joined.
अभिश्रुत॑ a. heard of, known, famous.
अभिषव m. pressing out (of the Soma).

आभिषेक (f. ई) relating to the inauguration of a
king.
अभि॑ष्ठित a. trampled or stepped upon.

अभिसंधि m. intention, purpose, interest, condition;
˚पूर्वकम् adv. with a fixed purpose.

अभिसार m. approach, attack;
 love-visit, appointment.
अभिसारिका f. a woman visiting her lover.

अभिसारिन् a. going to (—˚);
 f. ˚णी = prec.

अभि॑सृष्ट a. let loose, hastening to (acc.), allowed,
granted.
अभिस्वरे॑ prep. behind (gen.), lit. within calling.

अभि॑हत a. struck, smitten, beaten (drum), broken;
visited by, suffering from (instr. or —˚).

अभिह्रु॑त् a. bending, hurting;
 f. injury, defeat.

अभि॑ह्रुति a. bending, hurting;
 f. injury, defeat.

अभीत a. fearless;
 ˚वत् adv. as if not afraid.

आभि˚षेचनिक (f. ई) relating to the inauguration
of a king.
आभीर m. N. of a people & a caste.
